Specification: This specification models a simple parameterized configuration state with four variables initialized from constants. The system has a single initial-state predicate and a stuttering next-state relation that leaves all variables unchanged, so it represents a fixed configuration rather than an evolving algorithm. It also defines an invariant asserting concrete expected values for the variables, including a string literal, a set literal, and an inequality between two model-value-like constants.
